resources.string: Your data stays on this phone. No account needed.
Not set. Needed to recognise meal photos.
Ask for a PIN when you open Loop
Your PIN still works as a backup
Set up a fingerprint or face unlock on your phone first
Switch off anything you don\'t want Loop to track. Nothing already saved is deleted.
Loop recognises meal photos with Google\'s Gemini. It\'s free: you use your own key from Google AI Studio, so there\'s no account with us and no bill.
Meal photos you snap are sent to Google to work out what\'s on the plate. On the free tier, Google may use this content to improve its products. Nothing else from Loop is ever sent.
Paste a new key to replace it
Your key is stored encrypted on this phone only, is never shown again in full, and isn\'t included in backups.
Your steps, sleep, screen time, meals, moods and notes are saved only on this phone. There\'s no Loop server and no account.
The one thing that goes online
If you add a food photo key, meal photos go to Google Gemini to recognise the food. On the free tier, Google may use them to improve its products. Nothing else leaves your phone.
Android can back up Loop\'s data to your own Google Drive, the same way it backs up your other apps. You can also export a file yourself. Your PIN and API key are never included.
No microphone. No GPS left running. No reading inside your apps or the text of your notifications. No ads and no tracking.
Cycle logs are treated like everything else: kept only on this phone, never sent anywhere. Turn on app lock in Settings to keep them private, and the reminder never shows details on the lock screen.
Switch off any tracker in Settings, or any permission in your phone\'s settings. Raw details are deleted after 60 days; only daily totals are kept.

Rings fill up against these. Pick what\'s realistic for you; you can change them any time.
Loop uses these only to estimate how many calories you burn (Mifflin-St Jeor). They stay on this phone. Leave them empty if you\'d rather not.
Gender (also turns the period tracker on for women)
If Google backup is on for this phone, Android backs up Loop\'s data to your own Google Drive about once a day. Your PIN and food photo key are never included.
Saves everything as a JSON file you can keep or move to another phone.
Replaces what\'s on this phone with the file\'s contents.
Exported. Keep the file somewhere safe.
Everything on this phone will be replaced by the file. This can\'t be undone.
Wipes all your data, settings, PIN and key from this phone and starts fresh.
All your days, meals, check-ins and settings will be deleted from this phone. Export first if you want a copy. This can\'t be undone.
Some phones pause apps in the background to save battery, which leaves gaps in your day. Loop is light: it wakes at most every 15 minutes and never keeps GPS or the microphone on.
Loop can run in the background on this phone.
Your phone may pause Loop. Follow the steps below.
1. Open Loop\'s app settings › Battery saver › No restrictions.\n2. Turn on Autostart for Loop.\n3. In recent apps, pull Loop down to lock it.
1. Open Loop\'s app settings › Battery › Unrestricted.\n2. In Settings › Battery › Background usage limits, make sure Loop isn\'t in \"Sleeping apps\".
1. Open Loop\'s app settings › Battery › Don\'t optimise (or Unrestricted).\n2. Allow auto-launch and background activity if shown.\n3. Lock Loop in recent apps.
1. Settings › Battery › Background power consumption › allow Loop.\n2. Turn on Auto-start for Loop in i Manager.
1. Settings › Battery › App launch › Loop › Manage manually, and turn everything on.
1. Open Loop\'s app settings › Battery › Unrestricted (or Optimised off).
1. Open battery settings, choose All apps, find Loop and pick Don\'t optimise.\n2. If your phone has an auto-start or app launch setting, allow Loop.
